description.zh: 需要重置密码的账号名称。>仅支持重置普通账号的密码。
description.en: The name of the account whose password you want to reset. > Only passwords of standard accounts can be reset.

description.zh: 需要重置密码的账号信息，多个账号信息间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The account information for which you want to reset the password. Separate multiple account entries with commas (,).

description.zh: 实例id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 地域id。>您可以通过[describeregions](~~98041~~)接口查看可用地域。
description.en: The region ID. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query available regions.

description.zh: 需要重置密码的账号名称。>*仅支持重置普通账号的密码。*您可以调用[describeaccountlist](~~196844~~)接口查看目标实例的账号信息，包括账号名称
description.en: The name of the account whose password you want to reset. > *Only passwords of standard accounts can be reset.* You can invoke the [DescribeAccountList](~~196844~~) operation to query the account information of the target instance, including account names.

description.zh: 安全管理员账号的密码。>若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填。更多关于三权分置模式的信息，请参见[三权分立](~~213824~~)。
description.en: The password of the security administrator account. > If three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. For more information about three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx reset-account-password-restrict --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000 --account-name testaccount --account-password 00000 --security-account-name account_sec --security-account-password 00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx ResetAccountPasswordRestrict --region cn-hangzhou --SecurityAccountPassword 00000 --SecurityAccountName account_sec --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceName 'pxc-00000000' --AccountName testaccount --AccountPassword 00000
